meta.quote_refresh_policy: Hourly priority refresh of locked matches; Prediction Lock remains immutable. All bookmaker market names are parsed defensively; unsupported schemas are ignored.
meta.priority_policy: Grand Slam > 1000/Finals > 500 > 250 > Challenger > ITF; then Top 10/25/50/100 + Elo + ranking points

benchmark.sharp_liquidity_note: Not available in the current zero-cost data plan; never inferred.

meta.sport_specific_guard: Surface sample + surface-transition adaptation + recent workload/fatigue uncertainty
meta.cross_app_learning: Shared validation, audit, fail-closed and challenger discipline; sport model remains tennis-specific.
meta.note: NO BET first. Historical walk-forward calibration may unlock PAPER/TEST edges during cold start, but official ML remains blocked from VALUE until forward track-record health is mature. Multi-market simulation remains paper-only until family-level validation matures. Quote tape never rewrites a Prediction Lock.

risk.concentration_policy: Monitor tournament/surface clustering; no basketball-style correlation assumptions are imported.
